title: Long-term cancer survivors in Germany: prevalence, survival, cure and secondary tumours

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of all patients with a cancer diagnosis  (ICD-10: C00-C97 excluding C77-C80) since 2000 in Germany (Data of the Center for Cancer Registry Data (ZfKD); Data according to § 5 BKRG 2009).
